A few good
questions.

Can Agent Reach post?+

No. Agent Reach helps research public profiles and posts. Publishing needs Meta’s supported API or a scheduling service, connected by the account owner. This prototype has no connected social accounts.

How do spots work?+

A company can appear within a scene, in a host shout-out, or on a feature board between episodes on our website. On social, the board is part of a reel or its own post; we cannot control Instagram’s feed order. Paid partner placements are visibly disclosed. These examples feature our own companies.

Is reach guaranteed?+

No. Organic distribution earns attention through the story. Once publishing and analytics are connected, the useful measures are retention, qualified visits, and conversions.

Are episodes finished?+

These are original concept scenes and a captioned storyboard. They demonstrate the proposed format before a full voice, animation, and sound production pass.

Can both sites use this?+

Yes. The shared embed filters the same catalog for LaunchPlan or SpecFlow. The linked examples demonstrate the integration; the live company sites have not been changed.

What does a brief do?+

Your choices download as a JSON file on your device, ready for production review. It does not submit an order or publish anything.
